content: ज्योतिष्मत् {%a.%} [ज्योतिरस्त्यस्य मतुप्] .²1 Luminous, bright, shining, possessed of luminous bodies; नक्षत्रताराग्रहसङ्कुलापि ज्योतिष्मती चन्द्रमसैव रात्रिः <ls>R. 6. 22</ls>. .²2 Celestial. --{%m.%} .²1 The sun. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the third foot of Brahmā. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the seven suns appearing at the destruction of the world. .{@-ती@} .²1 The night (as illuminated by the stars). .²2 (In <ab>phil.</ab>) A state of mind pervaded by सत्त्वगुण {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} a tranquil state of mind.
